company: Bharat Engineering and Services Private Limited
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and organised executive to support the company's telecalling, lead generation, and digital marketing activities. The role combines direct communication with potential customers and hands-on execution of online marketing campaigns.

The selected candidate will contact prospective customers, follow up on business inquiries, manage paid advertising campaigns, support website search optimisation, and maintain the company's social media presence.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

**Telecalling and Lead Generation**

- Make outbound calls to prospective customers and follow up on inquiries received through the company's marketing channels.

- Introduce the company's fire safety products, solar energy solutions, and engineering services to potential customers.

- Understand customer requirements and identify suitable business opportunities.

- Qualify leads and arrange appointments, meetings, or site visits for the sales and technical teams.

- Maintain customer details, call records, follow-up schedules, and lead status in the company's CRM or designated tracking system.

- Coordinate with the sales team to ensure timely follow-up on inquiries and marketing-generated leads.

**Digital Advertising and Performance Marketing**

- Create, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).

- Assist in planning campaigns for lead generation, customer inquiries, website traffic, and brand awareness.

- Conduct keyword research, audience selection, and competitor analysis for relevant campaigns.

- Monitor campaign expenditure, clicks, inquiries, cost per lead, and conversion performance.

- Test different advertisements, audiences, and campaign settings to improve results.

- Work with the sales team to evaluate lead quality and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

**SEO and Website Optimisation**

- Perform keyword research and basic on-page SEO activities.

- Assist in optimising website content, page titles, meta descriptions, and landing pages.

- Monitor website traffic, search performance, and indexing using relevant digital marketing tools.

- Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility and generate relevant customer inquiries.

- Support search engine marketing activities through paid search campaigns and keyword optimisation.

**Social Media Management**

- Manage the company's business profiles on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

- Prepare a content calendar and schedule regular posts related to products, services, projects, and company updates.

- Write captions and coordinate the preparation of promotional creatives, banners, and short videos.

- Monitor social media comments and messages and forward relevant inquiries to the sales team.

- Review engagement and content performance to improve future social media activities.

**Reporting and Coordination**

- Prepare regular reports on calling activities, qualified leads, appointments, advertising performance, and social media activities.

- Maintain accurate records of lead sources and follow-up activities.

- Coordinate with the sales and technical teams to support lead conversion.

- Share customer feedback and campaign insights with the reporting manager.

- Work towards mutually agreed calling, lead generation, and marketing performance targets.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

- Minimum 6 months of experience in telecalling, inside sales, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Practical knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads is preferred.

- Basic understanding of SEO, paid search advertising, and social media management.

- Good verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to use spreadsheets, maintain records, and prepare basic performance reports.

- Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, CRM software, or conversion tracking will be an advantage.

Candidates with experience in solar energy, fire safety, electrical products, manufacturing, construction, or other B2B industries will be preferred.

**Educational Qualification**

Higher Secondary (12th pass) or a Bachelor's degree in any discipline. A certification in digital marketing or performance marketing will be an advantage.

**Skills Required**

- Customer communication and follow-up

- Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign management

- Basic SEO and website optimisation

- Social media content planning

- Lead management and reporting

- Analytical thinking and time management

title: Lead Generation - Digital Marketing
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Lead Generation - Digital Marketing Executive/Manager to build and drive Crystal Group's digital presence and generate qualifying leads through cold calling, market prospecting across target customer segments. This role owns the company's website, social media, content, SEO, and digital campaigns — while also supporting lead generation for the business development team. Candidates with Lead generation ability along with digital marketing experience in the warehousing or cold chain industry are strongly preferred; candidates with strong digital marketing experience in a related B2B, industrial, or logistics sector will also be considered.

**What You'll Do:**

*Lead Generation & Market Outreach*

* Drive lead generation across cold calling, digital campaigns such as Lusha, Apollo.io, LinkedIn outreach, references, databases, and platform listings — across all target industries and service lines,
* Ensure strong visibility and consistent inquiry generation across cold chain, warehousing, transportation, and blast freezing services

*Lead Qualification & Meeting Setup*

* Qualify leads, understand initial requirements, and filter high-potential prospects before passing to the NBD team
* Schedule meetings and site visits for the NBD Manager — ensuring only serious, relevant opportunities move forward
* Build qualification frameworks that improve conversion from inquiry to proposal stage over time.

*CRM, Pipeline Visibility & Demand Planning*

* Maintain CRM discipline and lead tracking — full visibility on pipeline stage, source, and conversion at all times
* Track campaign performance and sourcing channel effectiveness — improving lead quality and efficiency continuously
* Report pipeline metrics, lead quality trends, and market intelligence to the NBD Manager and leadership

*Digital Strategy & Brand Presence*

* Plan and execute Crystal Group's digital marketing strategy across website, social media, email, and paid channels
* Build and strengthen the company's digital brand presence as a leading pan-India cold chain and warehousing company
* Ensure consistent brand messaging, tone, and visual identity across all digital touchpoints

*Website & SEO*

* Own and maintain the company website — content updates, landing pages, and user experience improvements
* Plan and execute SEO (Search Engine Optimization) strategy — keyword research, on-page optimization, and content recommendations to improve organic visibility and traffic
* Monitor website performance (traffic, bounce rate, conversions) using tools like Google Analytics/GA4 (Google Analytics 4) and recommend improvements

*Content & Social Media*

* Plan and create content (posts, articles, case studies, videos) that showcases Crystal Group's facilities, capabilities, and industry expertise
* Manage social media channels (LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms) — content calendar, posting, and community engagement
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies/vendors for photography, videography, and design assets
* Plan and execute digital campaigns (paid social, Google Ads, email marketing) to generate qualified leads for the business development team

**Key Skills:**

* B2B lead generation, inside sales, or demand generation — with direct ownership of pipeline targets
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and terminologies — SEO, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media, email marketing, and paid campaigns
* Content creation and content strategy skills, with an eye for visual and messaging consistency
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics/GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite/Meta Pixel, and social media management tools
* Familiarity with CRM tools and basic lead-generation platforms (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io)
* Good understanding of B2B marketing and long sales-cycle industries

Pay: Up to ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Regional Key Account Manager (Southern)
description:
**Are you ready to get ahead in your career?**

* We want to empower you to turn your ambitions into achievements.
* We thrive in inclusiveness, diversity and embrace close collaborations for you to create impact for yourself and others.
* Together, we aim to bring the best of technology to help people, businesses and the nation to be ahead in a changing world.
* To realise our vision to become Malaysia’s leading converged solutions company, we are looking for a new talent to innovate and grow with us in a culture that values commitment, performance and possibilities.

**Why does this job exist and why is it critical?**

The Regional Key Account Manager (Southern) is responsible for executing HQ Key Account strategies across partner retail stores within the assigned region. The role serves as the critical link between HQ commercial planning and flawless in store execution, ensuring operational excellence, strong sales performance, and effective partner collaboration across both Modern Trade and Shop in Shop (SIS) partners.

**What you will do:**


1\. Execute Regional Strategies by implementing HQ Key Account strategies across regional partner retail stores to align with business objectives and drive sales performance for prepaid and postpaid products within assigned accounts.


2\. Translate Commercial Plans into clear, actionable in\-store initiatives to ensure consistent execution and enhance customer experience across assigned partner outlets.


3\. Monitor Modern Trade Operations by monitoring merchandising standards, SIM pack stock availability, and competitor activities within assigned partner outlets to ensure optimal brand presence and competitive advantage. Report findings and escalate issues to management.


4\. Support SIS Partner Operations by providing support to SIS Partner crews on Maxis products and systems, assisting with sales enablement and productivity across assigned outlets.


5\. Coach and manage Partner Stakeholder performance by building and maintaining strong relationships with store\-level partner stakeholders to foster effective collaboration and support regional outcomes.


6\. Ensure adherence to processes, standards, and KPIs within assigned accounts, identifying gaps and reporting them to management, and providing performance insights as required.

**Qualifications \& Technical Competencies**


1\. Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field


2\. Minimum 5\+ years in sales management, key account management, or retail operations, preferably in the telecommunications sector

* Strategy Execution (Advanced)
* Retail Operations Management (Experienced)
* Sales Performance Management (Advanced)
* Partner Relationship Management (Advanced)
* Team Leadership (Experienced)
* Data Analysis \& Reporting (Intermediate)
* Merchandising Standards (Experienced)

**What’s next?**

* Once you’ve applied online, our team will carefully review your application. Due to a high volume of applications, we appreciate your patience to allow for a fair and timely review process.
* Should you be shortlisted for the role, we will send you an invitation via email for a digital interview. You can also check on your application status by logging into your candidate account.


Maxis values diverse voices \& people. We hire and reward our employees based on capability \& performance — regardless of ethnicity, gender, age, education, religion, nationality or physical ability.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager with strong hands\-on expertise in planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant performance marketing platforms. The candidate should be analytical, ROI\-focused, and capable of driving quality leads, conversions, and measurable business growth.

The candidate must also have practical knowledge of implementing AI tools in day\-to\-day performance marketing work. This includes using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI powered platforms for campaign research, ad copy ideation, audience analysis, reporting automation, competitor research, workflow improvement, and productivity enhancement.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Campaign Strategy \& Planning \- Plan and execute paid media strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other platforms. Build full\-funnel PPC campaigns for awareness, lead generation, remarketing, and conversions. Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, keyword research, and campaign forecasting. Define campaign objectives, budgets, KPIs, expected outcomes, and optimization roadmaps.  
2\. Google Ads Management Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Remarketing campaigns. Conduct keyword research, negative keyword management, ad copy testing, and bid optimization. Optimize campaigns for CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and budget efficiency. Monitor Quality Score, impression share, search terms, auction insights, and conversion performance.  
3\. Meta, LinkedIn \& Paid Social Campaigns Plan and manage campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other paid social platforms. Create audience segmentation, retargeting funnels, lookalike audiences, and creative testing plans. Coordinate with design and content teams to improve ad creatives, messaging, landing pages, and CTAs. Analyze campaign performance by audience, creative, placement, device, geography, and funnel stage.  
4\. AI Implementation in Day\-to\-Day PPC Work \- Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other relevant AI platforms to improve campaign planning, research, content ideation, and execution speed. Apply AI for keyword expansion, competitor research, landing page analysis, ad copy variations, headline testing, and campaign hypothesis creation.

Use AI\-assisted workflows for reporting summaries, performance insights, dashboard interpretation, and weekly optimization recommendations.   Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PPC tasks such as reporting, data interpretation, creative brief generation, lead quality analysis, and internal campaign documentation. Collaborate with marketing, content, design, and automation teams to integrate AI into campaign workflows without compromising quality, accuracy, or brand standards.

5\. Tracking, Analytics \& Reporting \- Set up and monitor conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Conversion APIs, and relevant CRM integrations. Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and next\-step recommendations. Track CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, impression share, and budget utilization. Identify campaign gaps, wasted spend, tracking issues, and opportunities for scale.

6\. Optimization \& Growth \- Continuously test ad copies, landing pages, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and campaign structures.
